body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A major frustration we have is that there is no way to filter workflows in UI by a substring. The only way to filter now is "starts with" or "equal"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Filter by a substring

comments.body:
We are working on improving Visibility as whole that might enable us to implement this feature at scale. Thus, we don't have any plans to work on this feature in the short-term.
I'm closing the issue for now.

title: Add capability to filter workflows by a substring
